[Section] User study ::: Results
[source_id=82] Table TABREF33 describes the results obtained in the user study: the mean and standard deviation of percentage of answers in agreement with our model, the p-value, and the number of MTurk workers who completed each task. We find that the average agreement of human evaluators with our model is 70.40% over all 15 users in our dataset.
[source_id=83] For each of the 15 celebrities, the human evaluators agree with our model above a significance level of 0.05, and in 13 of 15 cases above a level of $10^{-5}$. This makes clear our scores are measuring what we intend to be measuring.
